entities.name: Contraption
entities.description: An artifact type on nontraditional Unstable cards, representing strange, overcomplicated machines that are often badly made or unsafe.

entities.name: Riggers
entities.description: Creatures that can assemble Contraptions, with no functional difference from a player doing so.

events.summary: Contraptions are introduced as an artifact type in Unstable, after the term first appeared as a joke on Steamflogger Boss.
events.quote: Contraptions were finally introduced in Unstable
